tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Free IBAN check (ISO 13616 check digits + country length), rate-limited per IP, no API key needed. For volume use the paid HTTP endpoint POST /v1/iban/validate (1 credit) — it has no IP limit.

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays for an EU country and year (2026-2028), optionally narrowed to a German region (e.g. BY). 2 credits, requires an API key.

tools.name: get_vat_rate
tools.description: Standard and reduced VAT rates for an EU country (EU TEDB). 1 credit, requires an API key.

tools.name: get_timezone
tools.description: Current UTC offset, DST flag and local time for an IANA zone (e.g. Europe/Berlin) or the zone list for a supported ISO-2 country code. 1 credit, requires an API key.

tools.name: get_fx_rate
tools.description: ECB reference rates. Omit from/to for the full latest table, or pass from+to (+amount, default 1) to convert. 2 credits, requires an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_iban · Private data: validate_iban, get_holidays, get_vat_rate, get_timezone, get_fx_rate · Public sink: validate_iban.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_iban · Private data: validate_iban, get_holidays, get_vat_rate, get_timezone, get_fx_rate · Public sink: validate_iban

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
